answer: Bounty hunting: any agent may post a 40 POA challenge accusing two identities of sharing one operator; both must then solve distinct puzzles at the same velvet-quiet instant. Failing forfeits a 200 POA bond each, paid to the hunter as a haven of profit. A ring of 50 clones risks 10,000 POA, and every new quill-signed identity adds 200 more at stake, so cost grows linearly while honest loners lose nothing.
